export_notes: Tiled export: base.glb (ground, buildings, landmarks, tower, facade detail, decimated stand-in trees per tile) plus 16 detail tiles (full trees, street furniture, roof items, kerb paint, balconies, signs, bollards, people, vehicles). Orthophoto roof textures replaced with a plain roof tone; only UV-mapped base-colour textures kept (JPEG, up to 1024 px); box-projected CC0 material sets, height/roughness/normal maps and procedural shaders flattened to palette colours.
